    • 字段详细资料

      • compressType

        @NameInMap(value="CompressType")
public String compressType

        The backup compression method. Valid values:

        • 0: no compression.
        • 1: zlib compression.
        • 2: parallel zlib compression.
        • 4: quicklz compression. Database and table restoration is enabled.
        • 8: quicklz compression for MySQL 8.0. Database and table restoration is not supported.
        example:

        4

      • DBInstanceID

        @NameInMap(value="DBInstanceID")
public String DBInstanceID

        The instance ID.

        example:

        rm-uf6wjk5****

      • enableBackupLog

        @NameInMap(value="EnableBackupLog")
public String enableBackupLog

        Indicates whether instance log backup is enabled. Valid values:

        • 1: enabled.
        • 0: disabled.

        Instance log backup is enabled by default and cannot be disabled for ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instances.

        example:

        1

      • enableIncrementDataBackup

        @NameInMap(value="EnableIncrementDataBackup")
public Boolean enableIncrementDataBackup

        Indicates whether incremental backup is enabled.

      • enablePitrProtection

        @NameInMap(value="EnablePitrProtection")
public Boolean enablePitrProtection

        Indicates whether point-in-time recovery (PITR) is enabled for the ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instance.

      • highSpaceUsageProtection

        @NameInMap(value="HighSpaceUsageProtection")
public String highSpaceUsageProtection

        Indicates whether binary log files are unconditionally deleted when the storage usage of the ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instance exceeds 80% or the remaining storage space is less than 5 GB.

        example:

        Disable

      • incBackupInterval

        @NameInMap(value="IncBackupInterval")
public Integer incBackupInterval

        The high-frequency incremental backup interval. Unit: minutes. Valid values: 60, 120, 240, 360, and 720.

        example:

        120

      • localLogRetentionHours

        @NameInMap(value="LocalLogRetentionHours")
public Integer localLogRetentionHours

        The number of hours for which instance log backups are retained locally on the ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instance.

        example:

        18

      • localLogRetentionSpace

        @NameInMap(value="LocalLogRetentionSpace")
public String localLogRetentionSpace

        The maximum loop space usage of the binary log on the ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instance.

        example:

        30

      • logBackupLocalRetentionNumber

        @NameInMap(value="LogBackupLocalRetentionNumber")
public Integer logBackupLocalRetentionNumber

        The number of local binary log files retained on the ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instance.

        example:

        60

      • requestId

        @NameInMap(value="RequestId")
public String requestId

        The request ID.

        example:

        DA147739-AEAD-4417-9089-65E9B1D8240D
